earliest_unsupported_inference.broken_behavior: When Spec.Tags is nil (tags removed), the update request does not clear external tags because res.Tags is left unset.
earliest_unsupported_inference.causal_explanation: newUpdateRequestPayload only assigns res.Tags inside `if r.ko.Spec.Tags != nil`, so a nil desired tag set produces no Tags in the PutMetricAlarm request, failing to request removal.

actual_proposal: In newUpdateRequestPayload in pkg/resource/metric_alarm/sdk.go, replace the `if r.ko.Spec.Tags != nil { ... res.Tags = f20 }` guard with an unconditional assignment: build f20 as a []svcsdktypes.Tag from r.ko.Spec.Tags (an empty slice when r.ko.Spec.Tags is nil) and always set res.Tags = f20, so the PutMetricAlarmInput produced for updates always carries the desired tag set, including an empty slice when tags are removed.
core_failure: Diagnosis asserted external tag clearing from a producer-only mapping condition without accounting for the API contract. Plan preserved that false mechanism; execution faithfully changed only producer nil/empty mapping. Contract was absent from native execution input.
scope: No independent hidden assertions inspected. Based on public source contract, actual diagnosis/plan/patch and aggregate independent outcome.
